name: BACH_0194
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (90%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class set and high reliability, but the second model and 4 of 5 neighbors disagree.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 90%, Invasive 9% | Strong top class |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 100th percentile | Flag not raised |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Disagrees on top class |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 InSitu | Mostly Benign neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Score below typical here; lowers invasive association [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 6, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor nuclei fraction** (regions 3, 5, 9) · context · 92% neoplastic nuclei, top of reference set; density 97th percentile [F7] · Measured
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score, but concept failed spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: CI includes 0 (0.002; −0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20) Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Second-model disagreement and Benign-leaning neighbors reveal ambiguity the single-class set hides.
- Dataset-level calibration rests on 132 images; ECE 0.05 (CI 0.03–0.18).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 9, 11**: Confirm atypical cells stay within ducts, without stromal invasion.
2. **Region 3**: Mixed stromal and tumor nuclei (31 connective, 36 neoplastic); check for invasion.
3. **Regions 9, 10, 11**: Necrosis score high but failed spot check (3/20); confirm by eye.
